close_reason:
Reshaped MdnSendResult and MdnParseResult to follow the canonical workspace pattern for #[non_exhaustive] types: derive Default; keep new(current_fields) stable; add with_<field>() builder setters per field; rustdoc 'Field-addition policy' section documents the non-breaking-evolution contract (future fields default via Default and use with_* setters, never extend new). Added 6 unit tests (default-is-empty + new-populates + with_setters per type). Quality gates: fmt + clippy --all-features + test --all-features + doc --all-features all clean.

Did NOT 'drop new' as the bead text suggested. The workspace canonical pattern (jmap-chat-server::ChatLimits) keeps new(positional_required_fields) stable and grows new fields via with_* setters; this avoids breaking existing internal call sites and matches the precedent. Mdn doc cites the ChatLimits precedent.

Cookie-cutter propagation: filed JMAP-q2wa.25 for the sibling extension-server Result types (CalendarEventParseResult / SetDefaultResult / OpResult) — they have the same shape and the same fragility; the canonical-template propagation rule requires the same fix there.
title: MdnSendResult::new / MdnParseResult::new defeat #[non_exhaustive] forward-compat
